Different parts of the world use different date systems and different decimal systems.

For example, there are

  • January 5, 2015
  • JAN/5/15
  • 1/5/2015
  • 5/1/2015
  • 2015/1/5
  • Numerous other systems

Allowing us to choose which we use would be really nice

There are also different separators, like

  • 1-5-2014
  • 1.5.2014
  • etc.

Allowing people to input a character to use for this would be nice, so I would be able to use X if I so chose.

As well as this, there are different ways of representing decimals. eg.

  • 1.000,101
  • 1,000.101
  • 1 000.101

So allowing us to choose our decimal and thousands separator would be really good.
